identity.mission: Create a top 1% luxury salon website that breaks category conventions.

headings.usage: All section titles, hero headings, and feature highlights.

body.usage: Paragraphs, navigation, buttons, and service details.

typography.installation: Import via Google Fonts in index.css: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Manrope:wght@300;400;500;600&family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,400;0,600;0,700;1,400&display=swap');

gradients.gold_text: bg-clip-text text-transparent bg-gradient-to-r from-[#D4AF37] via-[#F7E7CE] to-[#D4AF37]

colors.theme_strategy: Dark Mode Only (Luxury/Jewel Archetype). No light mode toggle needed as per 'Classic dark charcoal/black + gold' requirement.

visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle grain overlay on the background to avoid 'digital flatness'.

buttons.primary: bg-[#D4AF37] text-black hover:bg-[#b5952f] rounded-none uppercase tracking-widest font-bold px-8 py-4 transition-all duration-300
buttons.outline: border border-[#D4AF37] text-[#D4AF37] hover:bg-[#D4AF37] hover:text-black rounded-none uppercase tracking-widest px-8 py-4 transition-all duration-300

cards.style: bg-[#121212] border border-white/5 hover:border-[#D4AF37]/30 transition-colors duration-500 rounded-sm p-8
cards.hover_effect: Slight lift (-translate-y-1) and gold glow on hover.

navigation.style: Fixed glassmorphic header. Logo on left, Links center, 'Book Now' Gold Button on right.
navigation.mobile: Full-screen dark menu with large gold typography.

hero_section.content: Full-screen background image with dark overlay. Centered typography: 'Experience Luxury' in small caps gold, followed by 'Cut It Salon & Spa' in massive Playfair Display.

about_section.visuals: Large image on left, text block on right with 'Animated Counters' (Years, Rating, Clients) below text.
about_section.counters: Use gold numbers with small white labels.

services_section.style: Categorized lists (Hair, Spa, Facials). Each item has a price in gold. Use dotted leaders or space-between layout.

gallery_section.interaction: Zoom on hover. Lightbox on click.

reviews_section.style: Minimalist cards. Gold stars. Client name in bold.

location_contact.left: Contact Info + WhatsApp Button + Social Links.
location_contact.right: Styled Google Map (Dark Mode Map Styles).

universal_guidelines: Do not use 'Inter' for headings. Use 'Playfair Display'.
Do not use gradients for backgrounds, only for text or borders.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs (p-12, p-24).
Ensure all interactive elements have hover states (text color change, border glow).
All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes.
instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a single-page React app. Use the provided image URLs. Implement smooth scrolling. Use 'framer-motion' for entrance animations (fade-in up). Ensure the 'Book Appointment' button links to 'https://dikidi.app'. Add a floating WhatsApp button.
